channel: Story Time with Kenji (kids-songs/, formerly Rabbit Rhymes)

canvas.renderer: skia-python 144.1 raster surface over a numpy RGBA array

encode: ffmpeg libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p, one file per scene, joined with the concat demuxer -c copy; audio AAC 192k

caption.pop_in: scale 0.9 -> 1.0 over 0.14 s (ease-out), fade in 0.07 s, appears 0.05 s before the line is spoken
caption.position: centred; each scene sets its own cap_y (330-1720 px)

hook_card.box: x 38, width 1004, radius 30, #0B0B0D at 80 % with a soft shadow

vignette: radial, black 0 -> 60 % from half radius to 1180 px, centred at 46 % height (scenes can set vig)

transitions.cut: every scene dips up from black over 0.2 s (except the first)
transitions.end: fade to black over the last 0.9 s

scene_timing: a scene starts halfway through the pause before its first line and runs to the next scene's start
camera: per scene: (zoom_from, zoom_to, focus_x, focus_y) eased over the scene, or a function of time returning zoom, focus and optional screen point

character.height_px: about 510 x scale, head to feet; feet at (x, y)

look: flat shapes, no outlines on bodies, soft blurred drop shadows, muted interior palettes with one warm light, gentle constant zoom
